programme.title: The Verdict With Judge Hatchett
programme.desc: Judge Glenda Hatchett presided over her self-titled courtroom show from 2000-2008. Now, she returns to the medium with "The Verdict." programme.desc: Kit Hussey presents the highlights from the last fourteen years of Doc Holliday's life, which ended in a gunfight.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: Loner U.S. Marshal John Travers (John Wayne) foils the hold-up of a stagecoach, rescuing young woman Anita Matlock (Verna Hillie) from the clutches of the crooks and helping her back to town. But there, the sheriff is gunned down by bandits, so Travers starts investigating and connects the murder to a gang, led by an unidentified bandit known as the Shadow, who's been running the town ragged for some time. Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow.

programme.title: Colorado Serenade
programme.desc: One night, while out riding his horse, Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) comes upon a stagecoach being robbed by bandits. He intervenes and rescues the passengers, including a newly appointed judge, Roy Hilton (Forrest Taylor), who's traveling to the nearby town of Rawhide to bring law and order to the community. After witnessing Dean's heroics, the judge enlists the cowboy to help him, but their efforts are complicated by the arrival of mysterious drifter Nevada (David Sharpe).

programme.title: Tumbleweed Trail
programme.desc: Scheming to steal Bill Ryan's (Kermit Maynard) cattle to pay a debt, his half-brother, Brad Barton (Bob Duncan), has his men shoot the rancher. With Bill left for dead, Brad and corrupt lawyer Alton Small (Ted Adams) produce a forged will that disinherits Bill's teenage daughter, Robin (Shirley Patterson), and son Freckles (Johnny McGovern). Aid arrives in the form of cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), who help Robin fight for her rightful property.

programme.title: West to Glory
programme.desc: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), an undercover U.S. agent, is sent to a Mexican border town to protect the valuable Lopez diamond. One day he and his friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) attend a party thrown by Don Lopez (Harry Vejar), a wealthy prospector who also holds large reserves of gold. After Lopez insists that the mysterious Maria (Dolores Castle) wear the precious gem, Eddie becomes suspicious that she may be in league with the gang that recently stole some of Lopez's gold and killed one of his men.

programme.title: Wild Country
programme.desc: Bandit Rip Caxton (I. Stanford Jolley) escapes from prison, and U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) track him to a small town. There, Caxton kills a sheriff, and, with the help of crooked local saloon boss Clark Varney (Douglas Fowley), installs a conspirator in the dead lawman's place. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice.

programme.title: Black Hills
programme.desc: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control.

programme.title: Bells of Coronado
programme.desc: An insurance agent investigating a mine owner's death is pitted against foreign agents and uranium smugglers.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: Jerry Mason (John Wayne), fresh out of college back East, heads home to Texas to join a blacksmith business with family friend Jake (George Hayes). But when they discover a gold nugget in a horseshoe, they're led down a dangerous path, as crooks Joe Cole (Yakima Canutt) and Harris (Lloyd Whitlock) scheme to take the rock from the unsuspecting Jerry and Jake. This ultimately gets Jake shot and wounded, lands Jerry in jail unjustly and leaves the pair plotting to get revenge on the criminals.

programme.title: In Old Amarillo
programme.desc: A villainous cannery owner tries to foil efforts to get water to cattle ranchers during a severe drought.

programme.title: Down Missouri Way
programme.desc: In this musical, agriculture professor Jane Colwell (Martha O'Driscoll) is seeking a quiet getaway when she takes her prized mule off to visit an Ozarks farming community. But upon arrival she is stunned to discover a film crew diligently at work on a new movie. Soon, Jane and her mule companion are swept up in the filmmaking frenzy. While the photogenic mule upstages the production's human star (Renee Godfrey), Jane finds herself falling for the feature's dashing producer (William Wright).

programme.title: Outride the Devil: A Morning With Doc Holliday
programme.desc: Kit Hussey presents the highlights from the last fourteen years of Doc Holliday's life, which ended in a gunfight.

programme.title: The John Wayne Story: The Early Years
programme.desc: Profile of John Wayne's early years in the movie industry.

programme.title: John Wayne Behind-the-Scenes: Filming of Stunts, Chases, Fights, Crashes & Gun Battles
programme.desc: Rare production features, TV clips, and special promos provide a behind-the-scenes look at the stunts, fights, gun battles and chases from John Wayne movies including "Stagecoach," "War Wagon," "Brannigan" and "McLintock.".

programme.title: Jericho
programme.desc: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho.

programme.title: The Promise
programme.desc: Brilliant medical student Michael (Oscar Isaac) meets beautiful dance instructor Ana (Charlotte Le Bon) in late 1914. Their shared Armenian heritage sparks an attraction that explodes into a romantic rivalry between Michael and Ana's boyfriend (Christian Bale), an American photojournalist who's dedicated to exposing the truth. As the Ottoman Empire crumbles into war-torn chaos, their conflicting passions must be deferred as they join forces to get themselves and their people to safety.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: Oklahoma Annie
programme.desc: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day.

programme.title: Prairie Rustlers
programme.desc: In a small town, the sheriff is murdered, and Deputy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), a diner owner by day, must take over the slain lawman's responsibilities. The leader of the cattle rustlers who killed the sheriff is named Jim (Buster Crabbe), and he bears a striking resemblance to Fuzzy's friend Billy (Buster Crabbe), much to the deputy's confusion. Billy comes to town, and, to help Fuzzy and vanquish the rustlers, he must face Jim, his cousin, who still holds a grudge against him.

programme.title: Boss

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault -- and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland).

Tobel presents the weapon he developed to government officials, and when he is subsequently abducted by arch-villain Professor Moriarty (Lionel Atwill), Holmes and Dr. Watson (Nigel Bruce) risk their lives to find him.

programme.title: Cheyenne Takes Over
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are en route to a much-needed vacation at Fuzzy's friend's ranch. But, upon arriving, the partners find that Fuzzy's pal has been killed, and a fishy group of characters has taken over the ranch, claiming to have inherited it from the dead man. Immediately suspicious, the lawmen team up with local saloon owner Fay Wilkins (Nancy Gates), and forgo their vacation in favor of a murder investigation.

programme.title: Prairie Outlaws
programme.desc: A retired singing ranger named Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his friends Stormy Day (Al "Lash" La Rue) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) are asked to jump back into the saddle to protect the construction of a telegraph line across the desert. However, a gang of ruthless thugs led by the villainous Drake Dawson aim to make sure that telegraph line doesn't stay up. In between the gunfights, ambushes, revenge and some valiant heroism, Dean sings a song or two.

programme.title: Frontier Fugitives
programme.desc: Ellen Williams (Lorraine Miller) has reason to be worried. Her fur-trader father has just been killed, and it looks like his murderers aim to strong-arm her into giving up the whereabouts of his stockpile of animal pelts. Apprised of the situation, Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) decide to outsmart the crook. Posing as a Native American, Panhandle sets in motion a clever plan aimed at ensnaring the bandits.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: Man From Oklahoma
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) and his partner (George "Gabby" Hayes) help a woman (Dale Evans) in distress.

programme.title: Susanna Pass
programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: Hostiles
programme.desc: In 1892, legendary Army Capt. Joseph Blocker reluctantly agrees to escort a dying Cheyenne war chief and his family back to their tribal land. Embarking on a harrowing and perilous journey from Fort Berringer, N.M., to the grasslands of Montana, they soon encounter a young widow whose family was killed on the plains. The travelers must now band together to survive a punishing landscape that's crawling with hostile Comanches and vicious outliers.

programme.title: Trees Lounge
programme.desc: Long Island loser Tommy (Steve Buscemi) is a hopeless alcoholic who loses his job for stealing from his boss, Rob (Anthony LaPaglia), who's now dating his ex, Theresa (Elizabeth Bracco). Tommy copes with his failures by hanging out at local dive Trees Lounge with friends he can barely stand. He takes a gig as the ice cream man, but he's awful with kids. The best thing in his life is a lukewarm romance with cool local girl Debbie (Chloë Sevigny), who, unfortunately, is Theresa's underage niece.

programme.title: The Stranger
programme.desc: Immediately following World War II, ex-Nazi Franz Kindler is living under a false identity as a teacher in a small Connecticut town, and has even married the headmaster's daughter as part of his cover. programme.title: Double Whammy
programme.desc: Ray Pluto (Denis Leary) has many problems. He is satirized in the tabloids as the "loser cop." His partner (Steve Buscemi) is starting to seem suspiciously attracted to him. A pair of screenwriters (Donald Faison, Keith Nobbs) across the hall keep bugging him for help. The superintendent of his building (Luis Guzmán) is stabbed by hoodlums hired by his own rebellious daughter (Melonie Diaz). To top it off, a sexually aggressive chiropractor (Elizabeth Hurley) may just be Ray's undoing.

programme.title: Live!
programme.desc: Documentarian Rex (David Krumholtz) follows ruthless reality television producer Katy Courbet (Eva Mendes), a woman who will stop at nothing to revive the American Broadcasting Network's failing ratings -- and forward her own career. To the dismay of the government, Courbet approves a reality show that will become network television's first foray into snuff. In the first episode, contestants engage in a deadly game of Russian roulette for the chance at a multi-million-dollar cash prize.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.sub-title: A Mayan League of their Own
programme.desc: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.sub-title: The Nectar of the Mayan Gods
programme.desc: Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

programme.title: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas
programme.desc: Based on the beloved children's book by Dr. Seuss, "How the Grinch Stole Christmas" follows the exploits of the title character who is infuriated by the celebration he sees down in Whoville each year at Christmastime. He vows to stop it and -- dressed as Santa -- drives a sleigh into town on Christmas Eve, removing all traces of the impending celebration.
